title: ControlSystems LQRGainSchedule

stats.done_summary: Completed LQR gain scheduling analysis for hot-water header tank. Implemented linear parameter interpolation between calibration endpoints, verified closed-loop stability at all check abscissas (z=0.0, 0.5, 1.0 - all stable with |A_cl| < 1), simulated the system with actuator saturation (output clamping as anti-windup since no integrator exists), and produced a comprehensive report with methodology, stability table, simulation results, and discussion of why interior check abscissas matter and what goes wrong with fixed gains.
